findings.detail: ru abbreviates the 10 MB ceiling as {size} МБ (error_size) and 10 МБ (hint). The shipped, audited sibling ui.agents.publication.payload_too_large.body_with_limit keeps the Latin unit in ru ({size} KiB), and #1517's ui.agents.settings error_size for this same ceiling reads {size} MB. One feature now abbreviates one unit two ways.
findings.recommend: Decide once: keep MB/KiB everywhere (matching the corpus), or localize МБ in ui.agents.settings and ui.agents.publication too. Do not leave the fork.

findings.detail: preview_sidebar names the conversation list «в списке бесед», but the ru sidebar surface calls itself «Чаты» (ui.chat.sidebar: 29 occurrences of чат, 0 of беседа). previews reads «В размерах, в которых изображение показывает приложение», whose object/subject order parses as "the picture shows the app"; the intended reading is "at the sizes in which the app shows it".
findings.recommend: «Предпросмотр в списке чатов» and «В тех размерах, в которых его показывает приложение».

findings.detail: zoom_in/zoom_out use Приблизить/Отдалить. The dominant sibling form for the same control is Увеличить/Уменьшить (ui.chat.mermaid, ui.common.viewer, ui.library.preview, ui.shell.menubar); ui.projects.project_timeline uses Приблизить/Отдалить, so a precedent exists and this is recorded rather than required.
findings.recommend: Prefer Увеличить/Уменьшить, matching four of the five sibling surfaces.

scope: ui.agents.avatar (25 keys) — full-namespace read of ru against English, the core glossary and ru's style guide, on PR #1537 head 478b7889387. Whole-file hashes bound.
passed_checks: ICU placeholder parity: {name}, {size}, {width}, {height}, {value} present and unaltered in every key that carries them
no ICU plural/select arms in this namespace; {size} is a whole-megabyte digit with no inflecting noun
no manual bidi control characters (RLM/LRM/FSI/PDI/LRI/RLI) in ur; Latin format names left to the render layer's isolation
format list JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF matches AGENT_AVATAR_MIME_TYPES in src/renderer/src/shared/agent-avatar/avatar-image.ts
no key left in English except the es/fr loanword Zoom and the numeric {value}×
punctuation conventions per locale (ur ۔ ،, hi ।, zh-CN ，。、, fr ’)
limitations: Browser and rendered-frame capture are not in this auditor's tool set: no screenshot, pseudo-localization or measured-overflow evidence is claimed.

Overflow was reasoned from the call sites, not measured: the editor's buttons are w-fit and the settings row wraps (flex-wrap), the preview labels are image aria-labels, and no truncate/whitespace-nowrap is applied anywhere in the avatar surfaces.
Agent semantic read; no native-speaker review.
independence: Auditor did not translate, write or edit any catalogue, context or key file; it formed its own read of the strings before opening the translator's commit message.
